title: Wall Mount Double Glass Shelf 16-Inch With Gallery Rail - Waverly Place Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a wall mount glass shelf that adds two levels of organization while keeping essentials neatly in place.

  • Double shelf design provides extra space for toiletries and daily bathroom items
  • 3/8-inch thick tempered glass for safety and strength
  • Solid brass hardware supports enduring performance
  • Gallery rail designed to help keep items from sliding off
  • Concealed screw mounting for a clean, streamlined look

Specs

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
  • Overall dimensions: 16 inches L x 5 inches W x 8 inches H
  • Projection: 5 inches
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screws: #8 x 1 1/4)

Designed to coordinate with the Waverly Place collection for a transitional look and versatile bath accessories. Multiple designer finish options are available.

_previous.description: Add a flare of style to your décor with this decorative glass shelf. Shelf can be used anywhere in the home for a great space to store your products. Gallery rail will keep your items secure. Tempered glass is 3/8 Inches thick and all of the hardware is made of solid brass and finished with the highest quality materials to provide a lifetime of beauty.
